assertion.statement: For the actual imaginary quadratic K and trivial W=E[2]=F2², with all dyadic places in S, global cohomology vanishes above degree2 and h0-h1+h2=-2.
assertion.objects: Continuous Galois cohomology of G_K,S with the fixed finite module W.
assertion.hypotheses: K is imaginary quadratic, W is trivial of dimension2 overF2, and S contains all dyadic and archimedean places required by the source.
assertion.quantifiers: Every admitted K and finite support S satisfying these source hypotheses.
assertion.parameter_range: Finite2-primary coefficients over a number field without real places.
assertion.uniformity: The Euler characteristic is exact; the separate h1 estimate depends on the S-unit/genus calculation.
assertion.constants: h0=2, Euler characteristic=-2 and hence h2=h1-4.
assertion.normalizations: Ordinary imaginary-field cohomology; no real Tate correction is silently omitted.
assertion.exceptional_cases: This does not supply the h1 bound from generator counts alone and does not apply the same formula to a real field without modifications.
assertion.limit_order: Apply source cohomological dimension and Euler characteristic after fixing K,S,W; combine with the independently established h1 estimate.

assertion.statement: For each finite local field K_w and trivial W=F2², local duality and Euler characteristic give dimensions(h0,h1,h2)=(2,4+2d_w,2), with d_w=[K_w:Q2] at2 and0 elsewhere.
assertion.objects: Finite local Galois cohomology of the actual full rational2-torsion module W.
assertion.hypotheses: W is trivial rank2, the local field is a finite extension of its p-adic prime field, and the Weil duality identifies the relevant finite dual module.
assertion.quantifiers: Every finite place w in the stated local-condition diagram.
assertion.parameter_range: Finite local fields, including dyadic places with actual degree d_w.
assertion.uniformity: An exact local dimension formula; counting local conditions and rational primes is a separate argument.
assertion.normalizations: Local finite Tate duality and its Euler characteristic; derived Kummer degree-zero torsion remains in the later cone calculation.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Does not replace the actual Kummer/local condition by its free part or bound the whole comparison diagram.
assertion.limit_order: Compute full local Galois dimensions; then separately combine with the actual derived local-condition dimensions.
